name: MonarchScopeSelector
title: ScopeSelector
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of outlined group cards, each a MonarchCollapsible (androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility) holding a MonarchCheckboxGroup (androidx.compose.material3.Checkbox rows), with MonarchButton for Select all, Clear all and Show more
summary: Chooses the scopes (permissions) to grant, grouped by resource, with a count, Select all or Clear all per group and paging for long lists.
whenToUse: When creating or editing an API key, an OAuth app or an integration, to choose what it may access, grouped by API or resource.
whenNotToUse: For a few flat options use MonarchCheckboxGroup. For a person's role in a workspace use a MonarchSelect or radio rows.
api: @Composable fun MonarchScopeSelector(groups: List<MonarchScopeGroup>, value: List<String>, onValueChange: (List<String>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, showLabel: Boolean = true, defaultExpanded: Set<String> = emptySet(), pageSize: Int = 10, autoSelect: MonarchScopeSelectorAutoSelect? = null, expandIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, emptyContent: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchScopeSelectorLabels = MonarchScopeSelectorLabels())
class MonarchScopeGroup(id: String, label: String, scopes: List<MonarchScopeOption>, description: String? = null, loading: Boolean = false, emptyMessage: String? = null)
class MonarchScopeOption(value: String, label: String? = null, description: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true)

class MonarchScopeSelectorLabels(label: String? = null, empty: String? = null, loading: String? = null, noScopes: String? = null, count: ((selected: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, selectAll: String? = null, clearAll: String? = null, selectAllIn: ((group: String) -> String)? = null, clearAllIn: ((group: String) -> String)? = null, showMore: ((next: Int, remaining: Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: groups
options.description: The groups, in display order: id, name, scopes, a description line, a loading flag and a message for a group without scopes.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the whole new selection. Scopes of other groups keep their place.

options.name: enabled
options.description: When false checkboxes are disabled and Select all is hidden; groups can still be expanded to review.

options.name: showLabel
options.description: Shows the "Scopes" heading. When false the label is the selector's TalkBack name.

options.name: defaultExpanded
options.description: The ids of the groups expanded at first. Pass every id to expand all.

options.name: pageSize
options.description: How many groups show before "Show 10 more of 14", and how many more each press shows.

options.name: autoSelect
options.description: All or Added: a group with nothing selected gets every enabled scope once its scopes load, once per group. Added applies only to groups added after the first composition.

options.name: expandIcon
options.description: An icon after each group's name, such as a chevron pointing down, turned while expanded. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: emptyContent
options.description: Replaces "There are no scopes to choose from."

states.name: collapsed
states.description: Each group shows its name, its description, "2 of 5 scopes" and Select all or Clear all.

states.name: expanded
states.description: The group's scopes show as a checklist between the name and the count.

states.name: selected
states.description: A group with any scope selected takes the accent border; the count says the same in words.

states.name: loading
states.description: "Loading scopes…" replaces the count and there is no checklist or Select all.

states.name: no scopes
states.description: The group's emptyMessage or "No scopes available."

states.name: paged
states.description: A ghost "Show 10 more of 14" button under the shown groups.

states.name: empty
states.description: "There are no scopes to choose from." or emptyContent.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Checkboxes are disabled and Select all is hidden; expanding still works.

appearance: Groups are cards on the surface fill with the subtle border, or the accent border while any of their scopes is selected. Group names use the label style of MonarchCollapsible; descriptions and counts use the caption style in the muted text color. Checkboxes take the MonarchCheckboxGroup colors. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those roles.
platformNotes: The web puts the description and the count in the group's header button next to a chevron. On Android the header is MonarchCollapsible, which takes a text label, so the description, the count and Select all sit on a line under the header (under the checklist while expanded). The web shows a scope without a label as monospace code; here it is the plain value. The web's group icon is left out: it was decorative. The web's uncontrolled defaultValue is not offered: the selection is always hoisted. hideLabel becomes showLabel. After Show more the web moves focus to the first new group; Compose leaves focus to the system. Same name as iOS's plan; iOS has not built it yet.
accessibility: Each group header is one button with the state "Expanded" or "Collapsed" and the TalkBack expand and collapse actions, from MonarchCollapsible.
Scopes are checkbox rows read with their label, description and state; disabled scopes are announced as disabled.
Select all and Clear all are named with the group ("Select all in Projects API") and have 48dp touch targets.
The selected state of a group is the count in words, not only the accent border.
Without the visible heading, the selector is named "Scopes" for TalkBack.
edgeCases: Select all skips disabled scopes; Clear all leaves them as they are.
Scopes selected in value that no group lists are kept untouched.
Auto-selection runs once per group id, after its loading flag turns off.
Long group names and scope descriptions wrap.

examples.title: Scopes for a key
examples.template:
MonarchScopeSelector(
    groups = listOf(
        MonarchScopeGroup(
            id = {{groups.0.id}},
            label = {{groups.0.label}},
            description = {{groups.0.description}},
            scopes = listOf(
                MonarchScopeOption({{groups.0.scopes.0.value}}, description = {{groups.0.scopes.0.description}}),
                MonarchScopeOption({{groups.0.scopes.1.value}}, description = {{groups.0.scopes.1.description}}),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchScopeGroup(
            id = {{groups.1.id}},
            label = {{groups.1.label}},
            description = {{groups.1.description}},
            scopes = listOf(
                MonarchScopeOption({{groups.1.scopes.0.value}}, description = {{groups.1.scopes.0.description}}),
                MonarchScopeOption({{groups.1.scopes.1.value}}, description = {{groups.1.scopes.1.description}}),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    value = scopes,
    onValueChange = { scopes = it },
    defaultExpanded = setOf({{expanded}}),
    labels = MonarchScopeSelectorLabels(label = {{label}}),
)
examples.code:
MonarchScopeSelector(
    groups = listOf(
        MonarchScopeGroup(
            id = "projects",
            label = "Projects API",
            description = "Example Inc.",
            scopes = listOf(
                MonarchScopeOption("projects:read", description = "List and read projects."),
                MonarchScopeOption("projects:write", description = "Create, update and archive projects."),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchScopeGroup(
            id = "reports",
            label = "Reports API",
            description = "Example Inc.",
            scopes = listOf(
                MonarchScopeOption("reports:read", description = "Read generated reports."),
                MonarchScopeOption("reports:export", description = "Download reports as files."),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    value = scopes,
    onValueChange = { scopes = it },
    defaultExpanded = setOf("projects"),
    labels = MonarchScopeSelectorLabels(label = "Scopes"),
)
